text: Seabrook Town a remporté le match contre Harbour City sur le score de 4-2, grâce à une seconde mi-temps renversante. Malgré une avance de 2-0 obtenue par Harbour City grâce à Elias Okafor et Marek Barros, ce dernier élu joueur du match a vu ses efforts anéantis par l'intensité de Seabrook Town en deuxième période [#905] [#975]. Après une pause tactique à la 65e, Seabrook a pressé plus haut et joué plus direct, ce qui a créé plusieurs occasions franches [#1361]. Kian Romano a marqué deux buts cruciaux dans le temps additionnel, preuve de la capacité de son équipe à profiter des contre-attaques rapides [#1882] [#1906]. Seabrook a aussi dominé le jeu avec 22 tirs contre 10 pour Harbour, et 53,4% de possession, confirmant leur supériorité dans cette rencontre. Ce match a parfaitement illustré un combat entre un jeu patient et un pressing dynamique réussi.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in fr

- Seabrook Town won with a final score of 4-2 against Harbour City [#final_score].
- Marek Barros scored for Harbour City with a very low xG of 0.009 at 47' and was named player of the match with a rating of 9.8 [#975].
- Seabrook Town dominated the second half, scoring 4 goals with a combined xG of 2.71, compared to Harbour City's 0.25 [#second_half].
- Kian Romano scored two late goals in added time with high xG values of 0.609 and 0.959 to secure the win for Seabrook Town [#1882, #1906].
- Harbour City had fewer shots (10 vs 22) and less possession (46.6% vs 53.4%) overall, showing Seabrook Town's stronger control [#team_stats].

- Seabrook Town's late goals, especially from Kian Romano at 90+2' and 90+3', came from quick counter-attacks (e.g., the 90+2' goal involved a regaining of possession and a quick two-pass move ending with a through assist) and quick open play sequences, indicating their ability to exploit transitions effectively [#1881,#1882,#1905,#1906].
- Harbour City’s first goal at 45' was the result of a prolonged 17-pass build-up involving patient short passing, reflecting their 4-2-3-1 formation and coaching style emphasizing patient possession and short passes [#904,#905].
- Harbour City's second goal, a long cross from Marek Barros at 47', came from a corner situation, showing their utilization of set-piece opportunities to extend their lead [#973,#975].
- Seabrook Town's style emphasized wide, crossing play backed by their 3-4-3 formation; their equalizing goal at 69' came after a regain and a short multi-pass sequence, illustrating a more direct, pressing approach that increased after 65' when their coach changed tactics to press higher and play more direct [#1361,#1447,#1448].
- The tactical changes reflect Seabrook Town increasing their press intensity, directness, and defensive line height to chase the game, which helped them regain momentum and create more big chances in the second half [#1361].
- Harbour City’s higher pass accuracy and controlled build-up in the first half contrast with Seabrook's more dynamic direct play and pressing from the second half onwards, reflected additionally by Harbour City’s increased PPDA in the second half showing less pressing intensity [#670,#672,#1361].
